working_tree: Uncommitted build35 video preview, documentation and tests; no staging, commit or push.
request: Simple local video preview is sufficient. Native read-only playback with pause/play, progress, volume and aspect fit.
scope: MP4/MOV/M4V suffix dispatch before text decoding; separate video document ownership, no text buffer/undo/autosave/semantic text edits.
Paused initial item; user action starts playback. Canvas focus enables Space and Left/Right five-second jumps; controls include volume/mute and current/total time.
Native AVPlayerLayer aspect-fit rendering; SwiftUI owns only workbench controls and low-frequency transport state. Narrow panels use a two-row control layout.
Tab changes/close/workspace reset pause, remove KVO/periodic/end observers, cancel seek, detach item and cancel loader. Retain only position/volume metadata while inactive.
Background pinned descriptor and security-scoped access lease; exact private scheme URL, forbidden external references, utility-queue range service with no full-file copy.
One seek in flight plus latest pending target, obsolete asynchronous completions fenced by active/generation; no recreated player on progress updates.

budgets.limits: AVFoundation buffering preference and input limits are not hard decoder CPU/memory bounds. Synchronous I/O/framework calls cannot be forcibly interrupted; cancellation is cooperative. No real-time performance claim.

format_samples.fixture: 32x32, two frames, one second, no audio tracks, own temporary files
format_samples.scope: AVAssetWriter, asynchronous AVURLAsset metadata and AVAssetImageGenerator; no AVPlayer/AVPlayerLayer or application host created. Container suffix is not a promise for every codec.

checks.scope: Format, Clippy, Rust, C/C++ headers, locked notices, headless Swift models/processes/offscreen images and no-audio video samples, docs, diff.
Suffix, seek coalescing/clamp/time labels, secure bounded ranges, invalid/special/link/oversized files, cancellation, lease release, three containers, corrupt metadata and single-frame decoding.
checks.limits: Swift boundary only; Rust static library and Apple frameworks not instrumented. No player or audio playback.

checks.scope: Final app target compile and package; no final warnings/errors. Packaged notices and image dependency manifest bytes match source.

review.scope: Generation/seek callbacks, observer cleanup, tab close/reset, descriptor/access lease, private URL ranges and SDK request semantics. Follow-up reviewed stable layer player binding and narrow layout.
review.limit: Source review only; no GUI/player execution.

artifact.signing: Local development build; no distribution signing or notarization performed.

not_verified: Actual player first frame, colors/orientation/HDR/subtitles, video/audio playback and runtime decoder failures
Real controls, focus/Space/arrows, scrubbing, tab switching silence, narrow layout, VoiceOver and background behavior
macOS 14 or older OS codec support, additional codecs, large files, long videos, CPU/memory peaks and FPS
Network streams, MKV/WebM/AVI, speed/loop, subtitle/multitrack selection, video editing/export (not implemented)
No application launch, installation, distribution signing, notarization, publication, commit or push in this feature turn
